  • TRIPLE-SEAL ODOR Control, FROM DROP TO REMOVAL:The triple-seal system helps contain odors through diaper disposal, storage, and bag removal. Turn the rotating chamber after each drop to close off the opening and seal used diapers below. For better odor control, keep the top lid OPEN between uses with the rotating chamber in the ready position.*
  • NO SPECIAL REFILLS REQUIRED: Works with most standard 13-gallon household trash bags, including drawstring, flat-top, and handled styles—no proprietary refill rings, cassettes, or special liners to keep buying. Use bags you already have at home and replace them whenever needed. Includes 15 drawstring bags to get started.
  • EASY ONE-HAND DISPOSAL, LESS BENDING:Drop in the diaper and turn the handle for quick disposal, even when your other hand is holding baby. The extra-wide 5.71 × 5.12-inch opening accommodates bulky diapers with less pushing, while the 28.86-inch ergonomic height keeps disposal comfortably within reach.
  • LARGE 13-GALLON CAPACITY WITH EASY FILL CHECK:Holds up to 60 newborn diapers or 24 larger diapers to help reduce frequent bag changes and trips to the trash. The transparent rotating chamber lets you check the fill level at a glance, so you can make better use of each bag and know when it is time to empty.
  • DUAL-LOCK SAFETY & CLEANER BAG REMOVAL: The child safety lock helps keep the rotating chamber secured in its ready position, while the side fastener keeps the lid firmly attached to help deter curious hands and paws. When changing bags, the opening stays gathered as the lid lifts, allowing you to close the bag before removal for cleaner handling and less odor release. After replacing the bag, leave the top lid open for normal use.

    Overall Great Value!

    Reviewed in the United States on August 16, 2026
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Super happy with this diaper pail. I did a lot of research on other brands that were more expensive, and had great reviews as far as keeping smell at bay etc. I decided on this one, not only does it have a cute and modern appeal to it, but I love that it uses regular 13 gallon trash bags which means not having extra costs to what we’re already buying. I love the design of the product, you never come in contact with what’s inside the bag, the handle just goes up and down as you throw in a diaper, and removing the bag automatically shuts the bag. Changing the bags is pretty easy and the overall assembly of the product is super easy. Made of great and durable materials. It does a great job with smell, I personally never smell what’s inside. The only bummer is I wish it was slightly bigger so that it can fit more diapers. But maybe we’re just going through way more diapers faster than expected lol but it’s probably better that we have to throw out the bag more often than not.

    Worth every penny!!!

    Reviewed in the United States on September 11, 2026
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I absolutely love this thing. It looks like a space suit when you first open the box and it takes some figuring out on how to put the bag in but holy crap is it functional. I have no idea what the other buyers are talking about smells and being exposed to the content because the way the lid is designed you are never exposed to the inside of the can. When the handle is down the hole is open to place the diaper in a holding space. When the lid is up your opening closes and the cans hole opens. So you are necer exposed to the inside of the pail itself. It prevents my toddler from throwing his blocks or bottles in there and then i have to dig through poopy diapers to save them! Its amazing!! Worth every penny. And the best part is I can use regular 13 gallon trash bags but this one came with a roll, which it was a nice bonus. We actually bought this to replace the one we had and my toddler damaged. This was cheaper and so much better! I haven't needed to change the bag yet, we've only had it for 4 days but I don't forsee having any problems. Overall its a great buy!

  • Queen ViKKtoria
    1 out of 5 stars
    Verified Purchase

    Let me de-influence you

    Reviewed in the United States on October 2, 2026
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    This thing was horrible. On paper it seems amazing right? Nice wide opening, multiple seals to keep smell in supposedly, use my own trash bags, large capacity- I was so excited to get it. Our little guy is about to start solids and I know that's where the heavy-duty diapers start (pun intended). But there is a reason diaper pails have small openings, small capacity, specialized bags, etc- and we learned this the hard way.

    After the first 3 days of use, the entire room stunk and we have NEVER had diaper smell in this room before (used the Munchkin can). Also, when you pull the handle down to lower the top opening and place the diaper- you are hit in the face with a large gust of poop smell that was let into the chamber before the 'second seal' closed it off. Plus the sealing/handle mechanism is terrible- the diapers get caught in it constantly. Annoying at best when its a pee-only diaper but a disgusting mess to clean when it is a full diaper. Then there is the issue with the bags; I used the bags they provided the entire time so I know it was not the fault of my own trash bags. They are large which means significantly more time for smell to accumulate and fester. When you open the top, the drawstring is supposed to automatically pull closed thus again avoiding smell release but it doesn't work most of the time. The bag is heavy now, so the draw string pulls out of the lid before the bag is closed off. The trash bag itself is not made to hold in the smell of waste either- so unless you're using like landscaping debris bags you will likely also have the same problem.

    I returned this and went back to the Munchkin can and poof- no more smell in the room. The design is a bad idea for diapers and I would not recommend it to anyone

    An Absolute Must-Have for Every Nursery!

    Reviewed in the United States on July 28, 2026
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    The Momcozy Diaper Pail with Triple-Seal Odor Control has exceeded every expectation and has quickly become one of the best nursery purchases we've made.

    The first thing that impressed me was the quality of the construction. It feels sturdy, well-made, and designed to withstand daily use. The lid opens and closes smoothly, and every component feels durable and thoughtfully engineered.

    The triple-seal odor control is what truly sets this diaper pail apart. Even after multiple diaper changes throughout the day, we've been amazed at how effectively it locks in unpleasant odors. Our nursery stays fresh, and we no longer have to worry about lingering diaper smells spreading throughout the house. That alone has made a huge difference in our daily routine.

    I also love how convenient it is to use. The large capacity means we aren't constantly emptying it, which is a huge time-saver with two little ones. Changing the bags is quick, simple, and mess-free, and the wide opening makes disposing of diapers effortless.

    Another feature I appreciate is its modern, minimalist design. Unlike many diaper pails that look bulky or out of place, this one blends beautifully into the nursery décor and doesn't draw attention to itself.

    For the quality, durability, odor control, and convenience, I think it's an excellent value for the money. A product that truly delivers on its promise while making everyday parenting easier is worth every penny.

    If you're expecting a baby or looking to upgrade your nursery, I highly recommend the Momcozy Diaper Pail. It combines premium quality, outstanding odor control, and a sleek design into one product that has made life so much easier for our growing family.

About this Item

  • TRIPLE-SEAL ODOR Control, FROM DROP TO REMOVAL:The triple-seal system helps contain odors through diaper disposal, storage, and bag removal. Turn the rotating chamber after each drop to close off the opening and seal used diapers below. For better odor control, keep the top lid OPEN between uses with the rotating chamber in the ready position.*
  • NO SPECIAL REFILLS REQUIRED: Works with most standard 13-gallon household trash bags, including drawstring, flat-top, and handled styles—no proprietary refill rings, cassettes, or special liners to keep buying. Use bags you already have at home and replace them whenever needed. Includes 15 drawstring bags to get started.
  • EASY ONE-HAND DISPOSAL, LESS BENDING:Drop in the diaper and turn the handle for quick disposal, even when your other hand is holding baby. The extra-wide 5.71 × 5.12-inch opening accommodates bulky diapers with less pushing, while the 28.86-inch ergonomic height keeps disposal comfortably within reach.
  • LARGE 13-GALLON CAPACITY WITH EASY FILL CHECK:Holds up to 60 newborn diapers or 24 larger diapers to help reduce frequent bag changes and trips to the trash. The transparent rotating chamber lets you check the fill level at a glance, so you can make better use of each bag and know when it is time to empty.
  • DUAL-LOCK SAFETY & CLEANER BAG REMOVAL: The child safety lock helps keep the rotating chamber secured in its ready position, while the side fastener keeps the lid firmly attached to help deter curious hands and paws. When changing bags, the opening stays gathered as the lid lifts, allowing you to close the bag before removal for cleaner handling and less odor release. After replacing the bag, leave the top lid open for normal use.
